description: LiNaCO₃ crystallizes in the hexagonal P̅6 space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.42 Å. Li is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing LiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.08 Å. There are three inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.30 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.30 Å. In the third C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.31 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Li, and one C atom.
